{{Quote|A straight shot and a closed mouth looking for the right employer who appreciates loyalty and discretion. Call Demartinn. COMXCH 344-88.|Andasala Personals|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>}}
